# New encoder v6 fixtures

These `.osr` files were produced by the **OSREP 0.0.2 encoder** (`-m3`), not
by the legacy Omega SREP binary. They are golden archives for the new writer:
the reader must reconstruct the inputs generated by `tests/gen_corpus.sh` /
`tests/golden/inputs.sh`.

`manifest.tsv` is:

```
sha256 <TAB> id <TAB> input <TAB> args
```

The archive is `<id>.osr`. The inputs are `text.bin`, `tiny.bin` and
`zeros.bin` from the corpus, and the args are the encoder options used.

The old compatibility fixtures live in `tests/fixtures/v6/` and are not
modified here.
